findings.evidence: `rg` finds the definition at line 67 and only `typeBSpinRep_ι` at line 81; there is no `typeBSpinLieRep_apply` declaration.
findings.fix: Add a `@[simp]` theorem `typeBSpinLieRep_apply` equating evaluation with `spinAction Q P (P.typeBQuadraticEquiv b z hz x)`, and use it in `typeBSpinRep_ι`.
findings.issue: The public `typeBSpinLieRep` has no theorem describing its value on a Lie-algebra element; only the enveloping extension has an `ι` lemma.

findings.evidence: The definition uses `Fin.lastCases` at line 121, while `rg` finds no characteristic lemmas for `typeBSpinCorootWeight`; the basis-action theorem only returns the still-opaque weight name.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` equations for the `Fin.last` and `castSucc` cases of `typeBSpinCorootWeight`.
findings.issue: The public `typeBSpinCorootWeight` is opaque but has no equations exposing its values at `Fin.last n` and `j.castSucc`, so consumers cannot recover the advertised explicit weights without unfolding its body.

summary: Two public definitions lack elimination lemmas, forcing later consumers to rely on inaccessible implementation bodies.
